integrity: An exhaustive reproducible discrete-Morse checker and exact integer Smith reductions support the homotopy claim. Same-model review only; no independent mathematical validation.
limitations: The classification is for the fixed 20-vertex graph P4 Cartesian C5; it does not determine larger cylindrical families or symmetry representations. The particularly relevant 2026 three-row-grid primary full text was inaccessible; equivalent unindexed work cannot be excluded.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy of the pentagonal four-row cylinder matching complex
